_comment: Story gates: items from these namespaces/IDs can't be worn or used until the player has the KubeJS stage (granted by FTB Quests command rewards: /kubejs stages add @p <stage>). Namespaces of the hero packs are filled in after the first launch from kubejs/exported/tt_item_namespaces.json.

gates.message: The suit's systems stay dark. Its makers' secrets are revealed in Chapter 8: The Rise of Heroes.
